note: Every upstream Helm chart the site stack installs, vendored under deploy/charts/vendored/ (D-13, D-21). sha256 is the digest the chart repository's index.yaml publishes for that version, confirmed against the downloaded tarball; renders and installs read only the tarball. Download and check: node deploy/charts/vendor.mjs [--check]. The compliance fit check reads this file (chart:<name>).
